title: Cross-Site Transformers Are Robust Heart Rate Estimators
abstract: arXiv:2611.28366v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Single-site heart-rate estimation from photoplethysmography (PPG) degrades sharply under real-world motion. Multi-site PPG provides a natural solution, but existing models fuse sites as generic sensor channels rather than exploiting their hemodynamic structure: each heartbeat propagates along the arterial tree, appearing across body sites as delayed and transformed copies of the same cardiac event. We propose the Cross-Site Transformer, which introduces a hemodynamically informed inductive bias by restricting multi-sensor fusion to cross-attention between PPG sites. On WildPPG, the largest in-the-wild benchmark available, our model establishes a new single-model state of the art, reducing error by 21% over the previous best and 35% over the best prior transformer. translated_title: 跨部位Transformer是鲁棒的心率估计器
translated_abstract: 基于光电容积脉搏波（PPG）的单部位心率估计在真实世界的运动干扰下性能急剧下降。多部位PPG提供了一种天然的解决方案，但现有模型只是将多个部位作为通用传感器通道进行融合，而没有利用其血流动力学结构：每一次心跳都会沿动脉树传播，在身体各部位表现为同一心脏事件的延迟且变换后的副本。我们提出了跨部位Transformer（Cross-Site Transformer），通过将多传感器融合限制为PPG各部位之间的交叉注意力，引入了带有血流动力学信息的归纳偏置。在目前最大的真实场景基准数据集WildPPG上，我们的模型建立了新的单模型最优水平，相比此前最佳方法将误差降低了21%，相比此前最佳的Transformer模型降低了35%。这种跨部位限制同样使得训练后的网络可以直接审计。由于每个交叉注意力头都位于部位之间的一个有向通路上，因果重采样消融（原文摘要在此处截断）……
tldr: 该论文提出跨部位Transformer，通过将多部位PPG的融合限制为部位之间的交叉注意力来编码血流动力学先验（即心跳沿动脉树传播的特性），在WildPPG基准上将心率估计误差降低了21%，创造了单模型新纪录，且网络具有可直接审计的优越性。
en_tdlr: The Cross-Site Transformer restricts multi-sensor fusion to cross-attention between PPG sites, introducing a hemodynamically informed inductive bias that captures how heartbeats propagate along the arterial tree, achieving a new single-model state of the art on WildPPG by reducing error by 21% while making the network directly auditable.
